name: bug-fix
description: Diagnose and fix a reported bug with regression tests
request_pattern:
Bug report: ${bug_description}

Diagnose the root cause, implement a fix, and add a regression test that would have caught this bug. Do not change unrelated code. Explain the root cause in the patch rationale.

variables.bug_description: Describe the bug here: what happens, what should happen, steps to reproduce
